rule: Every item must have an HS code of at least 6 digits
Total declared value must equal the sum of quantity × unit price across all items (within 1%)
For each item, units per carton × cartons must equal quantity
Total cartons on the booking must equal the sum of cartons across all items
Weight per pallet (total gross weight ÷ pallets) must not exceed the chosen carrier's max weight per pallet
No lithium batteries, aerosols or flammable liquids
Total gross weight must be at least the sum of unit weight × quantity across all items
Shipments to a warehouse must have a delivery appointment booked
Every item must have a country of origin
Ready to ship date must not be in the past
